comparison.objective: Screen finishing media from metal washers vs refit a long wardrobe rail into two unlike supports.
comparison.physical_skill: Agitate orientation-dependent particles through apertures vs bimanually swing and tilt a long rigid rail into constrained end supports.
comparison.success_condition: Mass recovery and retained washers with no spill plus released dwell vs both rail ends seated, rail level, still, and grippers clear.
comparison.reason: Generic bimanual load sharing is shared, but aperture sifting and long-part insertion are meaningfully different.
